tools.name: Mass Dispel
limitations: Removes harmful Magic from up to five friendly targets
Removes one beneficial Magic effect from up to five enemy targets

tools.name: Power Infusion
limitations: Twenty percent Haste for fifteen seconds

tools.name: Guardian Spirit
limitations: Prevents one otherwise-fatal hit unless the damage is too large

tools.name: Power Word: Fortitude
limitations: Does not stack with an equivalent Fortitude effect

tools.name: Phantasm
limitations: Removes snares only, not every root or harmful Magic effect

tools.name: Mind Soothe
limitations: Reduces detection range by ten yards
Only affects Humanoid and Dragonkin enemies
Does not make the party invisible

tools.name: Shackle Horror
limitations: Only affects Aberration and Undead enemies
Only one target can be shackled at a time

provenance.description: Current Midnight Holy guide identifies Purify, Improved Purify, Dispel Magic, Mass Dispel, Power Infusion, Fortitude, Psychic Scream, and Guardian Spirit.
Current Purify record confirms healer Magic removal and Disease removal from Improved Purify.
Current Guardian Spirit record confirms its friendly target, healing increase, death-prevention behavior, and cooldown.
Current Patch 12.1.0 Holy dungeon guide provides per-dungeon Mass Dispel, Phantasm, Mind Soothe, Improved Purify, and Shackle Horror guidance.
Current Mind Soothe, Phantasm, and Shackle Horror records establish detection, self-snare, and creature-control boundaries shared by Priest healers.
